correctness.rationale: Invertible congruence reduces full unrestricted simplex minimax to minimum trace diagonal PSD majorant of inverse Gram. Explicit primal slack and complementary dual correlation matrices in each sign/triangle regime certify optimality. Equality forces uniquely each diagonal. Rational exact verifier tested 553 SPD Gram triples across all 3 regimes and the 2/5 transition, and 800 independent numerical minimizations agreed. Finite tests are supportive, not the proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural smallest unsymmetric (three-row) sample-design classification replaces generic SDP optimization by exact rational formulas, distinguishes sign frustration from balanced inputs, proves uniqueness, and identifies an exact spectral-multiplicity transition at a nontrivial threshold. This is more than a numerically recomputed table or a routine substitution; it resolves the optimal design law across all real invertible three-row matrices under the sharp one-step criterion.
